title: The Pete Jolly Trio Yeah CD 1996 VSOP Records Jazz Piano Chuck Berghofer
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
The Pete Jolly Trio - Yeah! (V.S.O.P. #98 CD, 1996).
V.S.O.P. Replica Edition Phonorecords, Very Special Old Phonography.
Recorded at Sage & Sound Studio, Hollywood, October 10 and 11, 1995.
Cover and liner photos by William Claxton; liner notes by Ed Barr.

Pete Jolly, piano; Chuck Berghofer, bass; Nick Martinis, drums.

1. Yeah! (4:34)
2. Variations (5:09)
3. The Man I Love (6:19)
4. Ah-Moore (6:58)
5. Lullaby Of The Leaves (4:45)
6. Crazeology (3:56)
7. Dream Dancing (5:37)
8. The Red Door (4:21)
9. Ill Wind (6:37)
10. Never Never Land (4:29)
11. Wonder Why (5:15)
12. Diablo's Dance (5:40)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
